thrown_melee.name: Thrown Melee Weapon
thrown_melee.summary: Throw a held melee weapon: DEX+Athletics, grenade launcher DVs, 25 m max; normal damage but SP not halved.
thrown_melee.unmodelled: Any melee class can be thrown with its own dice; this entry is the light (knife) case. Weapon lands at target.

thrown_grenade.name: Thrown Grenade
thrown_grenade.summary: Hand-thrown grenade: DEX+Athletics vs grenade launcher DVs, 25 m max, same damage and blast as launched.
thrown_grenade.unmodelled: Cost and payload come from the grenade ammunition type (ammo slice, p.344-347); no Basic grenade exists.

air_pistol.name: Air Pistol
air_pistol.summary: Paintball pistol: no damage. Acid balls strip 1 SP from the armour at the hit location instead. Ammo priced as medium pistol.
air_pistol.house_rule: Sold loaded with acid paintballs (same price, p.347); plain paint would do nothing in a fight.

battleglove.name: Battleglove
battleglove.summary: Armoured gauntlet holding three Cyberarm option slots; donning or removing costs an Action and blocks the arm's own options.
battleglove.unmodelled: Its attacks are whatever Cyberarm options are installed (bought/installed at cyberarm prices); options in the arm underneath are unusable while worn. Bare-glove punch = Brawling (combat slice).

hurricane_assault_weapon.name: Constitution Arms Hurricane Assault Weapon
hurricane_assault_weapon.summary: ROF 2 drum-fed shotgun, 16 shots; no Aimed Shots, two-Action reload, needs BODY 11+ unless mounted.

dartgun.name: Dartgun
dartgun.summary: Very heavy pistol loading 8 Non-Basic Arrows only (poison, sleep, etc.); reloads like a pistol.
dartgun.unmodelled: Payload effects come from the loaded arrow type (ammo slice).

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.summary: Shotgun firing only incendiary shells via Heavy Weapons; ignited targets take 4/turn until they spend an Action. No crits, no Aimed Shots.

kendachi_mono_three.name: Kendachi Mono-Three
kendachi_mono_three.summary: Excellent two-handed crystal monoblade; with its biometric key, armour below SP11 is ignored entirely.
kendachi_mono_three.house_rule: Comes keyed to its owner's biometrics, so the SP11 cut always works for whoever carries it.

malorian_arms_3516.name: Malorian Arms 3516
malorian_arms_3516.summary: Johnny Silverhand's Excellent very heavy pistol: 5d6, built-in Smartgun Link that must be connected for it to fire.

microwaver.name: Microwaver
microwaver.summary: No damage; a hit forces DV15 Cybertech or two cyberware/electronics items (GM pick) go dead for a minute.
microwaver.house_rule: The two pieces knocked out are the first installed cyberware with a combat effect (the book has the GM pick).

cowboy_u56.name: Militech "Cowboy" U-56 Grenade Launcher
cowboy_u56.summary: ROF 2 grenade launcher, 4 grenades, takes every grenade type; two-Action reload, BODY 11+ unless mounted.

rhinemetall_emg86.name: Rhinemetall EMG-86 Railgun
rhinemetall_emg86.summary: Railgun rifle on Heavy Weapons, 4 shots, ignores armour below SP11; no Autofire/Aimed Shots, two-Action reload, BODY 11+.

shrieker.name: Shrieker
shrieker.summary: Sonic pistol: no damage; a hit forces DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs or Damaged Ear. Deafens the shooter too without ear protection.
shrieker.house_rule: A Level Damper counts as ear protection for the shooter; carried ear protectors wait for inventory.

stun_baton.name: Stun Baton
stun_baton.summary: One-handed less-lethal club: would-be kills leave the target Unconscious at 1 HP; no crits, no armour ablation.

stun_gun.name: Stun Gun
stun_gun.summary: Less-lethal heavy pistol on battery packs: drops targets Unconscious at 1 HP; no crits, no armour ablation.

tsunami_helix.name: Tsunami Arms Helix
tsunami_helix.summary: Autofire-only rifle, 40 rounds, burns 20 per attack, multiplier up to 5; no single shots or Aimed Shots; BODY 11+.

poor.name: Poor Quality
poor.summary: Cheaper; jams on a Critical Failure (natural 1) and needs an Action, no Check, to clear.

standard.name: Standard Quality
standard.summary: Baseline weapon as listed; the book also calls this Average Quality. All exotics are this unless stated.

excellent.name: Excellent Quality
excellent.summary: +1 to Attack Checks with the weapon; costs one price tier up.
